# Question: generator-shortcuts

## Strongest plausible shortcut

`panel_direction_only` is the strongest identified rival. It treats the two zero separator rows and columns as a 3×3 panel grid and moves the central 9 one step according to the **target panel**. The intended rule instead moves independently on an axis exactly when the raw marker-to-target distance on that axis exceeds one. The rival fits all 4 labeled canonical pairs because none places the 6 more than one cell away while remaining in the marker's separator band.

## Exact disagreement input

The final production generator emits a counterexample at:

- seed `913`;
- sample index `0`;
- difficulty `hard`;
- input dimensions `27×22`;
- input SHA-256 `516ef19529d2d5f2e7dcfc08d46cc3bff70282e63104b41cdb0d4fab7af0cd65`.

The complete exact grid, intended output, rival output, replay metadata, and source hashes are in:

`repo/generators/a85f5274d2ae/counterexamples/panel-direction-only/reproducer.json`.

On that grid the 9 is at `(9,15)` and the 6 at `(7,19)`. The target is still inside the middle row band but is two rows above the marker. The intended rule therefore moves the intermediate 9 to `(8,16)`. The panel rival moves only right and leaves its intermediate 9 at `(9,15)`. The outputs differ at exactly those two cells.

## How the output was checked

I generated the input through the final selected module, verified that `strict_canonical_like` accepts it and `same_panel_far_axis` fires, and executed it through the supported selected Racket bridge. The Racket receipt is `checks/counterexample-panel-direction-only/racket.json`; executed rule hash is `bba3b44960f2`. Its output exactly matches the Python rule mirror. The focused regression test is:

`test_reviewer_repairs.py::test_declared_panel_shortcut_fits_canonical_and_generated_witness_refutes_it`.

## Does production emit such cases?

Yes. Two of every four default schedule roles are same-panel far-axis witnesses. In the final semantic sample the witness fired in 298/600 draws (easy 111, medium 92, hard 95). Every four-pair window contains two such witnesses, so every 3-demo hold-one-out rotation retains at least one. This establishes coverage against this declared rival, not against every imaginable shortcut.
